integrity: The exact polynomial identity and root bracket are independently replayable from the included verifier. The literature comparison is statement-level and records residual risk rather than treating search failure as proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to translation-invariant positive boundary laws for the generalized-wand compatibility graph on the Cayley tree of order 2; no claim about periodicity classes, extremality, free energy, or arbitrary tree order.
title: Exact algebraic critical point for the generalized-wand Blume–Capel HC model
